svg.title: B2 METERS top view
svg.text: FRONT EDGE: jacks face the glands (box front wall)
B2 METERS: top view, 1:1 at 9 px/mm, SolderFul SOLDERBREAD#02 81.3 x 50.8 mm
solid line: jumper or wire on top
ring + tick: lead to another board or off the stack
diamond: pad with a soldered lead
gold dashed circle: M3 standoff (hex corners)
grey dashed box: plug or lead keep-out
down to B1: 3V3 down to the B1 back + rail (22 AWG,
up to B3: bus 3V3 up to B3 (22 AWG, 20 mm)
up to B3: bus GND up to B3 (22 AWG, 20 mm)
up to B3: bus SCL up to B3 (22 AWG, 20 mm)
up to B3: bus SDA up to B3 (22 AWG, 20 mm)
up to B3: bus MUX_RST up to B3 (22 AWG, 20 mm)
up to B3: bus CUPS up to B3 (22 AWG, 20 mm)
up to B3: bus VANE up to B3 (22 AWG, 20 mm)
up to B3: bus RAIN up to B3 (22 AWG, 20 mm)
